newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Heiton names corporate development executive.
newsitem.headline: Heiton names corporate development executive.

text.p: Heiton Holdings Plc said on Monday that it had appointed Paul Lynch as corporate development executive, with effect from April 28.
Lynch joins Heitons from Riada Corporate Finance Ltd where he was an associate director with responsibility for management of the firm's BES (Business Expansion Scheme) Funds department.
His role at Heitons will be the identification and evaluation of new business opportunities for the group, including potential acquisitions, Heitons said in a statement.
